purpose: Replace a tests-only LiteRT call with the approved version-pinned public-constructor compatibility recipe while preserving strict native accelerator flags.

apiContract.singletonNpu: The pinned SDK adds CPU when NPU is the only accelerator and its private auto-fallback flag has the default value.
apiContract.npu: Public Options(NPU, NONE) retains those two enum entries; CPU is not inserted.
apiContract.qualification: NPU plus NONE is verified compatibility behavior of the pinned 2.4.1 artifact, not a documented cross-version strict-NPU guarantee.
apiContract.testingGetter: getAccelerators is VisibleForTesting(PACKAGE_PRIVATE); only unit tests invoke it. Production uses neither restricted method, reflection nor a lint suppression.

nativeContract.finding: NONE advances the input index without adding a hardware flag. NPU enum identifier 3 maps to native bit mask 4; enum identifiers must not be OR-ed as bit masks.
nativeContract.method: Independent inspection of exact approved API bytecode and packaged native JNI disassembly; no native inference was executed.

arm64Observation.reason: w24 is initialized to 0 at 0x207b0. Table entry 0 branches directly to 0x2084c, which advances the input index. CPU, GPU and NPU branch to OR 1, OR 2 and OR 4 respectively. The accumulated value is stored into options at 0x20884.
arm64Observation.qualification: Read-only disassembly of approved ARM64 JNI member. No native code executed; no hardware placement claim.

preservedBehavior: Qualcomm HTP performance mode remains SUSTAINED_HIGH_PERFORMANCE.
The Mimi transformer remains an explicitly requested CPU graph with the configured thread count.
The language model and vocoder retain strict GPU or NPU native masks.
Graph opening, failure propagation, cleanup and cancellation checks are unchanged.
Receipts still distinguish requested placement from measured placement, with kernel_attribution=NOT_MEASURED and hardware_qualified=false.

guardBoundary.enforcement: Build-time dependency verification and actual-SDK contract tests. Updating LiteRT requires re-review of both Kotlin selection and native enum-to-mask behavior.
guardBoundary.runtimeLimitation: The pinned Kotlin API offers no unrestricted resolved-accelerator or actual-backend getter. This change adds no runtime placement detector and does not claim one.
guardBoundary.invalidRequest: The helper rejects CPU and NONE as requested accelerated graph backends.

validation.compiledSourceScope: Full incoming PocketCompiledRuntime.kt and PocketCompiledOptions.kt, PocketCompiledDecoder.kt, PocketCompiledSpeechCatalog.kt, VoiceSpeechBackend.kt and the actual incoming test class with one added JNI enum identity assertion.
validation.realDependency: The tested classes.jar is byte-identical to the approved AAR member.
validation.sourceDto: LocalVoiceAsset is copied exactly from its production declaration.
tests: Production GPU options resolve to GPU alone, with no CPU or Qualcomm options.
Plain singleton NPU control exposes SDK CPU insertion; production NPU options resolve to NPU and NONE without CPU, and retain the pinned JNI enum identifiers 3 and 0.
Qualcomm JIT and sustained performance policy remain unchanged.
CPU and NONE inputs are rejected as accelerated graph requests.
validation.productionBytecode: Compiled PocketCompiledOptionsKt and PocketCompiledRuntime companion contain no restricted setter, testing getter or reflection reference; the runtime calls the public-constructor helper.
limitations: This is a host API-contract check, not Android application compilation or release lint.
No native model compilation, GPU/NPU inference, kernel placement, listening quality or hardware qualification is claimed.

exactSourceAvailability: Google Maven litert-api-2.4.1-sources.jar returned 404; exact-release conclusions use approved bytecode and native binaries, not main-source extrapolation.
